questions.answer: Reasonably good, I'd say. My business studies involved plenty of accounting and statistics, and I often helped my father with his shop accounts, so I'm fairly [[proficient]] with everyday calculations and budgets.

questions.q: Did you enjoy maths at school?
questions.answer: I did, mostly. I liked that there was always a clear answer, unlike essay questions. Geometry was my weak point, though, and some of those proofs left me utterly [[baffled]].

questions.q: Is there a number you consider lucky?
questions.answer: Not really, to be honest. I'm not very [[superstitious]] about numbers. I know many people have a lucky one, but I've never felt that any particular number has made a difference in my life.

questions.q: Do people in your country believe in lucky numbers?
questions.answer: Some do, though it's not as big a thing as in some other countries. You'll occasionally hear of people paying extra for a phone number with a [[distinctive]] pattern, but most people don't take it too seriously.

questions.q: Do you think people remember numbers less than they used to?
questions.answer: Definitely. I remember knowing dozens of phone numbers by heart as a child, but now I barely know my own sister's. We've [[outsourced]] our memory to our phones, which is convenient but slightly worrying.
